summary: Grammar explanation (in English) of consonant gradation in type 1 verbs: strong grade in the infinitive and third-person forms, weak grade in first and second person; model conjugation of antaa (nt → nn).
transcript:
[KIEL]IOPPI
Verb type 1 and KPT

There are a lot of type 1 verbs with KPT changes. The consonant(s) are the same in the dictionary form and the hän and he form. First person and second person verbs have weak grade, the infinitive (dictionary form) and the third person forms have the strong grade. The verbs in the previous example chart are type 1 verbs.

antaa (to give)
nt → nn
minä annan      me annamme
sinä annat      te annatte
hän antaa       he antavat
